_doc: EXAMPLE sponsor task-automation rules for one edition. Copy to config/sponsor.<edition>.json and edit. The sponsor task DEFINITIONS (titles, audiences, completion) live in code; their body text lives in config/tasks/<edition>/sponsor/*.md. This file carries what stays per-edition: deadline rules, webshop product classification, contact roles, the swag catalogue and the per-tier booth specs. Community-specific text is written as {{placeholder}} markers resolved from event.<edition>.json -> placeholders.

deadlineRules._doc: Named deadline rules referenced by the sponsor task definitions. basis 'eventMinus' = event start date minus N days; 'eventEndPlus' = the event's last day plus N days; 'contractPlus' = the sponsor's first-order date plus N days, with fallbackNowPlus used when no order date is known.

orderImport._doc: Column mapping for a webshop order export (manual CSV import; mirrors what the WooCommerce pull produces). Sponsor identity keys on email.

sponsorContacts._doc: A sponsor is a COMPANY with several contacts and roles. With a company directory integration enabled, companies/contacts/roles come from it and this list maps its role ids to labels; without it, the hub manages contacts itself using these roles. reminderTargeting decides who receives sponsor task reminders.

reminderTargeting._doc: ASSIGNED task: the assignee is primary and all coordinators are copied. UNASSIGNED task: all coordinators are primary. Signers never receive reminders.

productClassification._doc: How each ordered webshop product is classified, by its category text and/or its name (never a static product-id list, so next edition's products need no config change). A product may match several types; each matched type's tasks are added. Matching is substring and case-insensitive.

rules._doc: Logistics add-ons (furniture, TV rental, extra staff tickets). Recognised so they are not reported as unmatched, but they generate no tasks.

swagCatalog._doc: The sponsor swag catalogue IS the webshop: every product in the category named here is shown with its own price, picture and description. bagQuantity is how many pieces one bag order is. currencySymbol is shown beside prices (empty = bare numbers).

zohoSponsorCategoryMap._doc: Optional (Zoho Backstage only). Webshop product CATEGORY -> Backstage sponsor CATEGORY. A company buying in several categories gets one Backstage sponsor record per heading. Needles are substring, case-insensitive, against the same category text productClassification uses.

boothWallSpecs._doc: Per booth tier: wall size, the wall-design spec file, the webshop coupon for included furniture, the number of booth members included and the furniture guidance. Substituted into booth tasks as {{wallSpecUrl}}, {{couponCode}} and {{furnitureSpec}} for the company's classified tier.

Coupon code: **{{couponCode}}**

Choose the furniture included with your booth in the webshop. You must place an order to secure it, even when it is fully covered by the coupon.
